project_name: Pause App - Refined Category Art & Optical Sizing
overview: Refinement guidelines for category artwork recognizable replacements, Dachshund vitality update, optical icon scaling across Home and Topics screens, and Curiosità content integration without altering core palettes or fonts.

revised_artwork.subject: Dachshund
revised_artwork.refinement: More alive and organic styling, warm fur highlights, expressively animated eyes, eliminating frozen glass statue appearance.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Beuta / Lab Flask
recognizable_art_replacements.details: Erlenmeyer flask with glowing vibrant liquid and subtle rising bubbles.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Lush Tree
recognizable_art_replacements.details: Organic tree silhouette with multi-layered canopy foliage.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Open Book
recognizable_art_replacements.details: Classic open book with fanning pages and subtle central illumination.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Stacked Coins
recognizable_art_replacements.details: Metallic currency coins stacked in three-quarter perspective with edge sheen.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Artist Palette
recognizable_art_replacements.details: Painter palette with distinct color dabs and dynamic paintbrush.

recognizable_art_replacements.subject: Globe
recognizable_art_replacements.details: 3D-rendered globe sphere showing continents and latitude/longitude grid.

curiosita_status.action: All 28 real stories and lessons seamlessly reassigned into primary semantic categories (Scienza, Storia, Natura, Cultura, Tecnologia, etc.). No dedicated Curiosità card required.

home_screen_cards.artwork_scaling: Reduce artwork subject bounding box to ~68px-72px (approx 70-75% of container height) to create negative space around edges.
home_screen_cards.text_alignment: Category name and lesson count placed cleanly below/around art with text-xs/text-sm hierarchy and min 4.5:1 contrast.

topics_explore_screen_cards.artwork_scaling: Scale internal SVG/illustration subject down by 15-20% relative to card outer frame to avoid visual edge collisions.
topics_explore_screen_cards.padding_safety: Minimum internal padding of 10px-12px (p-3) around icon center.

surface_and_contrast_rules.theme: Dark atmosphere with coordinated app colors.
surface_and_contrast_rules.overlays_and_headers: NO fully transparent backgrounds under active text/navigation. Use backdrop-blur with minimum bg-slate-900/80 or dark solid fill.
surface_and_contrast_rules.card_borders: 1px subtle semi-transparent border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) to define touch bounds without heavy shadows.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, category cards, navigation links, and story cards MUST contain data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="category-card-scienza", data-testid="topic-filter-item").
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.typography: Use established app typography system with strict size hierarchy (H1 max text-4xl/5xl, body text-sm/base, overlines text-xs with tracking-wider).
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.motion: Apply micro-interactions on touch/hover states (scale: 0.98 on press, smooth opacity transitions). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against dark background surfaces.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify category-artwork rendering uses the newly specified recognizable symbols (Beuta for Scienza, Tree for Natura, Open Book for Cultura, Stacked Coins for Economia, Palette for Arte, Globe for Geografia).
Ensure Dachshund artwork in Animali category renders with warm organic liveliness.
Adjust icon dimensions inside category-artwork renderers so icons are scaled slightly smaller (70-75% card bounds) on Home and Topics screens.
Ensure all category touchcards include valid data-testid props.
Maintain dark theme background fill on headers and overlays (no transparent floating panels).
